items.text: Virtual Machine Scale Set agent pools

lab.title: Faster, Reliable Pipelines
lab.scenario: Builds wait 30 minutes for an agent and one network call fails a build every few days.
tasks: Create a scale set agent pool that grows with demand
Run tests in parallel across three agents
Add timeouts and retries to the flaky step
Measure queue and run time before and after
verify: Queue five runs at once – New agents start and the queue clears.
Run the split test job – Total test time drops.
Fail the network call once – The step retries and the build passes.

outline.assessment: Participants size an agent pool for a given number of daily builds and justify the result.
